title: Hand the agent the CARD, not its pixels: video cards and OS files by reference, drops stay in the panel
description: Rewritten 2026-09-26 with Fabio (brief.md holds the detail). The agent receives the CARD, never its pixels: handing Cosmo a card says which card is meant, and it looks only when the task needs it. The thumbnail is feedback for the user only (composer chip + chat bubble). The server half already works that way (routes/agent.js by-reference staging, agentLoop.mjs ~2081 gives the model one text line). Three UI faults: (1) a VIDEO card dropped on the panel reaches the agent as its 512 thumb.webp, because cardAttachmentSource rejects non-images and the drop falls back to dataTransfer.files; it must go by reference as { url, name, mediaType: 'video', itemId, groupId }. (2) The drop also lands in the prompt box (MpiPromptBox's window drop listener); the panel must stop propagation once it handles a drop. (3) A file dropped from the OS becomes a gallery card FIRST (uploadMediaFile + media:imported, the service the prompt box already uses), then goes by reference. Out of scope: look seeing clips via services/cardView.js (message a082a6a6, MCP3). Done = the todo gate in tests/agent-video-attachment.test.cjs passes, no double drop, OS files land as cards. Verify mode: user-ux.
